in_marathi.name: Ashwathama
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Horse among men
in_marathi.long_meaning: Ashwathama हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Ashwatthama, also known as Duryodhana's brother, was a great warrior and a key figure in the Mahabharata. He was born from the divine Ashwattha tree and hence the name 'Ashwathama'. He is revered for his valor and unwavering devotion to Duryodhana.
